name: 49802 · Kingsford, MI
findings: ZIP 49802 (Kingsford) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49802 (Kingsford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
